implementation: Seven workstreams (licensing and activation; Central administration; guest sign-in, portal and capacity; networking and enforcement; financial and PMS; appliance administration security, audit, backups and retention; retention, performance and platform) implemented the approved decisions and were integrated on one branch. Each AD item ends in IMPLEMENTED, ACCEPTED-RISK, DOC-ONLY or EVIDENCE-DEPENDENT in docs/AUDIT_DECISION_DISPOSITIONS.md. Accepted risks are not recorded as fixed: AD-25 (IPv6 forwarding kept), AD-29 (voucher format kept, residual risk documented), AD-37 step 4 (hotel-wide feed rule kept), AD-8 parts. Evidence-dependent items are listed with what to run.
migrations: Appliance 0162-0178 (renumbered contiguously from the workstreams' reserved ranges): sign-in capacity and limits, one-round-trip throttle charge, NFC names, post-stay by room and reservation, enforcement policy, charge backoff and parking, refused-reversal case, operator transfer reason, retired PMS provider secrets, superseded RESYNC copies, late-capture review, authenticated erasure ledger, retention preview, usage roll-ups, accounting index, hourly export totals, scrubbed event rows. Central 0059-0062 (waiting-appliance cap, second-step locks per address, replacement and retirement settings with fetch counts, deleted-appliance history archive). The production baseline was regenerated through 0178. The authenticated-ledger key is created on first use because a baseline-built appliance carries no migration-inserted rows (found by the integration harness).
toolchain: Go 1.26.10 pinned by digest (golang:1.26.10) in all three modules and the build and CI scripts; x/net v0.62.0, x/crypto v0.58.0.
verification: Unit suites of license, control-plane and data-plane on Go 1.26.10; the Phase-5 full-schema integration harness (every migration, baseline and Gate-P, with the edged, scd, payment, stayengine, iamv2 and enforce suites) passing apart from two Windows-host file-mode tests that pass on Linux; clean-install reconstruction PASS; migration location and grant durability PASS; cloud-admin 253 and hotel-admin tests and both typechecks. Kernel behaviour of the new nft rules, MAC binding, the 500-client burst and Linux restore drills are EVIDENCE-DEPENDENT and listed in docs/AUDIT_DECISION_DISPOSITIONS.md.
